title: 第576章 从现在开始我是你2第575章 从现在开始我是你1
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
杨犴以为周元只是装样子，取笑他，可渐渐地，他眼眸剧烈晃动，泛起了从来没有过的惊恐。
只见周元在他身旁，翻出了一面铜镜，看看他，看看铜镜，那手在脸上不停摸索，跟捏泥人似得，一点点的捏出了他的模样。
“像不像？”
周元对比着杨犴和铜镜里的模样。
“你……你……”
杨犴意识到了周元的目的，胸口开始剧烈起伏，鲜血大股大股的从嘴里冒出来。
“不是很像，但只要不是很熟悉的人，应该看不出问题。”
周元轻轻拍了拍浮生面具。
就这样了。
定型吧。
“我会让你名动灵墟的。”
周元握着镰刀，落到了杨犴的脖子上：“说谢谢！”
“不……不……”
杨犴眼神里泛起浓浓的恐惧，他几乎能想象到，这个疯子伪装成他，会干出多少疯狂的行动，甚至可能威胁到血炼岛其他人。
“别客气了，这叫礼尚往来。两年前龙墟岛的事，我可一直记得呢。”
周元挥动镰刀，划开了杨犴的喉咙。
就像刚刚他划开那巨骨血虎一样。
深达颈骨，鲜血喷涌而出。
杨犴抬起手，死死捂住伤口，可鲜血像是决堤的洪水奔涌不绝，很快带走了他的生机，也滞涩了意识。
周元蹲到杨犴身旁，摘下了他的储物袋。

从里面翻出了刚刚那颗血虎的血核、一件血袍、一袋子灵石、一瓶补血的丹药、一块血炼岛的令牌，以及一部血书。
“血炼诀？”
周元看着上面猩红的大字，眼底倏然泛起亮光。
之前在云雾山里捡的血修之法，果然是来自于血炼岛。
但他那部只是残卷，不知道被多少人反复修改过。
周元翻开血书，仔细研究起来。
熔炼血气，冲开掌心的窍穴，以窍穴为源，吞炼生灵血气。在窍穴里面熔炼出纯净的精血，滋养血肉筋骨，以达到淬体强身，充盈血气的效果。
跟之前捡到的残卷，几乎相差无二。
唯一不同的是，这里面开劈窍穴的方式，是通过吞炼血兽的血核，而不是残卷里的那样生吞兽血。
应该是血兽难寻，无奈修改了开窍之法。
“就这么简单吗？”
content_en:
Yang Ran thought that Zhou Yuan was just pretending to make fun of him, but gradually, his eyes shook violently, and he felt panic that he had never seen before.
I saw Zhou Yuan beside him, turning out a bronze mirror, looking at him, looking at the bronze mirror, his hands kept groping on his face, like squeezing a clay figure, shaping his appearance bit by bit.
"Does it look like it?"
Zhou Yuan compared Yang Wan's appearance with that in the bronze mirror.
"You...you..."
Yang Yan realized Zhou Yuan's purpose, his chest began to rise and fall violently, and blood came out of his mouth in large streams.
"It's not very similar, but as long as you're not very familiar with it, you shouldn't see the problem."
Zhou Yuan patted the Fusheng mask gently.
That's it.
Let’s finalize it.
"I will make you famous in Lingxu."
Zhou Yuan held the sickle and placed it on Yang Yan's neck: "Say thank you!"
"No...no..."
There was deep fear in Yang Yan's eyes. He could almost imagine how many crazy actions this madman would do if he disguised himself as him, and he might even threaten other people on Blood Refining Island.
"You're welcome, this is called reciprocity. I still remember what happened on Longxu Island two years ago."
Zhou Yuan swung the sickle and slit Yang Yan's throat.
Just like when he sliced ​​open the giant-bone bloody tiger just now.
It reached as deep as the neck bone, and blood spurted out.
Yang Ran raised his hand and covered the wound tightly, but the blood rushed like a flood that burst a dam, quickly taking away his life and stagnating his consciousness.
Zhou Yuan squatted next to Yang Wan and took off his storage bag.
The blood core of the blood tiger, a blood robe, a bag of spirit stones, a bottle of blood-replenishing elixir, a blood refining island token, and a blood book were found inside.
"Blood Refining Technique?"
Zhou Yuan looked at the big scarlet characters on it, and his eyes suddenly lit up.
The blood cultivation method I picked up in Yunwu Mountain before really came from Blood Refining Island.
But his work is only a fragment, and it has been revised repeatedly by countless people.
Zhou Yuan opened the blood book and studied it carefully.
Smelt the blood and energy, open the acupuncture points in the palm, and use the acupoints as the source to swallow the blood and energy of living beings. Pure essence and blood are smelted in the acupoints to nourish the flesh, muscles and bones to achieve the effect of tempering the body and strengthening the body and filling the blood.
It is almost the same as the scraps I picked up before.
The only difference is that the way to open the acupoint here is to swallow the blood core of the blood-refining beast, instead of swallowing the beast's blood raw as in the fragment.
It must be that the blood beast is hard to find, so I had no choice but to modify the method of opening it.
"Is it that simple?"
